title: Sections 6.3 & 6.4 — Vectors and Dot Products (30 Cards)

cards.front: What is the component form of the vector from P(2,3) to Q(5,7)?
Define the magnitude of vector $\mathbf{v} = \langle a,b \rangle$.
What does it mean for two vectors to be equivalent?
cards.back: They have the same magnitude and direction (or the same components).

cards.front: Compute $\langle 1,4 \rangle + \langle 3,-2 \rangle$.
What is scalar multiplication of a vector?
cards.back: Multiplying each component by the scalar: $k\langle a,b \rangle = \langle ka, kb \rangle$.

cards.front: Find $2\langle -3,5 \rangle$.
What is the zero vector?
If $\mathbf{v} = \langle -2,5 \rangle$, what is $\|-\mathbf{v}\|$?
What is a unit vector?
cards.back: A vector with magnitude $1$. To get the unit vector in direction of $\mathbf{v}$, divide $\mathbf{v}$ by $\|\mathbf{v}\|$.

cards.front: Find a unit vector in the direction of $\langle 3,4 \rangle$.
What are the standard unit vectors?
Write $\langle 7,-2 \rangle$ as a linear combination of $\mathbf{i}$ and $\mathbf{j}$.
How do you find the direction angle $\theta$ of $\mathbf{v} = \langle a,b \rangle$?
cards.back: $$\tan\theta = \frac{b}{a}$$, adjust quadrant based on signs of $a$ and $b$.

cards.front: A vector has magnitude $10$ and direction angle $30^\circ$. Find its components.
What is the direction angle of $\langle 0,5 \rangle$?
Define the dot product of $\langle a,b \rangle$ and $\langle c,d \rangle$.
What kind of quantity results from a dot product?
State the property $\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{v}$.
Compute $\langle 2,-1 \rangle \cdot \langle 1,2 \rangle$.
What does it mean if $\mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v} = 0$?
If $\mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v} > 0$, the angle between them is ___.
Write the formula for the angle $\theta$ between two nonzero vectors.
Find the angle between $\langle 4,3 \rangle$ and $\langle 3,5 \rangle$.
What is the projection of $\mathbf{u}$ onto $\mathbf{v}$?
In the decomposition $\mathbf{u} = \mathbf{w}_1 + \mathbf{w}_2$, what is $\mathbf{w}_1$?
cards.back: $\mathbf{w}_1$ is the projection of $\mathbf{u}$ onto $\mathbf{v}$ (parallel to $\mathbf{v}$). $\mathbf{w}_2$ is orthogonal to $\mathbf{v}$.

cards.front: Define work $W$ done by a constant force $\mathbf{F}$ moving along displacement $\mathbf{d}$.
A force of $50$ lb pulls a door $12$ ft at an angle of $60^\circ$. Find the work done.
If force and displacement are perpendicular, what is the work?
A plane flies east at $200$ mph, wind north at $30$ mph. What is the resultant speed?
What is the difference between the two components in the decomposition $\mathbf{u} = \mathbf{w}_1 + \mathbf{w}_2$?
cards.back: $\mathbf{w}_1$ is parallel to $\mathbf{v}$, $\mathbf{w}_2$ is perpendicular to $\mathbf{v}$.
